itinerary.title: Aswan and embarkation
itinerary.source: You board in Aswan and lunch is served on board.

itinerary.title: Kalabsha, Beit Al Wali, the Kiosk of Kertassi
itinerary.source: The ship sails south through the afternoon toward Wadi es-Sebua, mooring there for the night.

itinerary.title: Wadi es-Sebua, Dakka, Maharraqa and Amada
itinerary.source: The third day is the fullest of the cruise and the most varied.

itinerary.title: Qasr Ibrim and Abu Simbel
itinerary.source: You spend the afternoon at Abu Simbel and moor for the night nearby — time to return to the temples after the day-trip groups have left.

itinerary.title: Departure from Abu Simbel
